name: Relaxation_via_Constraint_Ablation
description: Instead of phrasing the certificates as "reducing to a subset of tasks" which models instantly map to independent sums, this rewrite frames them as "relaxing by removing orthogonal constraints". This leaves a single active constraint (either precedence or grid capacity) acting on the tasks, forcing the model to logically deduce that a single active precedence constraint implies `p1+p2`, and a single active capacity constraint implies a sum of durations, defeating simple pattern matching.
